description: This file is a script for seeding user data into a MongoDB database for the freeCodeCamp project, including handling command-line arguments, connecting to MongoDB, and inserting predefined user data.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles errors during database operations, logs error, closes client connection, and exits process.

methods.name: dropUserTokens
methods.description: Deletes user tokens from the database for specified user IDs.

methods.name: dropUsers
methods.description: Deletes users from the database for specified user IDs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main async function that connects to MongoDB, clears existing data, inserts new user data based on command-line arguments, and closes connection.
